purpose: Records the protocol changes that took effect when WLEP was renamed to WELP. Distinguishes naming-only changes from any methodology change.

naming_changes: Active protocol full name 'WumboLabs Model Evaluation Protocol' -> 'WumboLabs Evaluation Lifecycle Protocol'.
Active protocol files: WLEP Phase Structure.md -> body content renamed to WELP Phase Structure.md (file rename to WLEP Phase Structure alias file kept).
Living note: 'WumboLabs Model Evaluation Protocol (WLEP).md' -> new canonical 'WumboLabs Evaluation Lifecycle Protocol (WELP).md' + legacy alias note.
Future contract IDs: prefix welp- (successor to wlep-).
Future conformance filename: WELP-CONFORMANCE.md (successor to WLEP-CONFORMANCE.md).
Future conformance JSON key: welp_conformance.json (successor to wlep_conformance.json).
Future schema filenames: welp_*.schema.json (successor to wlep_*.schema.json).
Future toolchain preflight const: welp-preflight (successor to wlep-preflight).
Future validator path: validate_campaign_welp.py (successor to validate_campaign_v2.py; the frozen file is also kept).
First WELP snapshot id: welp-next-snapshot-2026-08-26-post-rename (successor to wlep-next-snapshot-2026-08-26-post-apodex).
preserved_changes: All historical wlep-next-snapshot-* IDs remain valid.
All historical wlep- contract filenames and SHA-256s remain valid and immutable.
All historical wlep_*.schema.json filenames and SHA-256s remain valid and immutable.
All historical campaign WLEP-CONFORMANCE.md files and apodex/nemotron/lfm/qwen3.8 evidence remain unchanged.
Historical Lab Record directory names like lab-records/<model>/wlep-<YYYY-MM-DD>/ are filesystem provenance; never renamed.
The 'OMP profile alias' --profile wlep-apodex in campaign-local OMP evidence is preserved verbatim.
change_log.validators_added: validate_campaign_welp.py (5 fixtures: legacy WLEP, current WELP, WELP-with-legacy-evidence, unknown-prefix rejection, silently-rewritten-legacy rejection).
change_log.operator_summary: Same protocol, different name. Frozen WLEP evidence reproduces unchanged; new WELP campaigns use the WELP snapshot and WELP-named successor contracts/schemas/validators.

operator_decision_required: Choose a LICENSE for the public WELP repo (out of scope for the migration agent; human).
Initialize git in the public WELP repo (out of scope; human).
Decide whether to commit the HivemindVault rename + new WELP overview note (out of scope; human).
